|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Send A Detachment Down (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on opponent's droid, weapon or device. Target your trooper at a different location. When trooper reaches target, this card goes on trooper; trooper is power + 2, target is "stolen", and you retrieve Force = destiny number of target.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on opponent’s card (a device, droid, or weapon) that may be stolen by a character. Target your trooper at another location. When reached by target, place this Utinni Effect on target; target is power +2, steals opponent’s card, and you may retrieve 3 Force.” '''What changed:''' “opponent's” → “opponent’s card (a device,”; removed “weapon”; “device.” → “weapon) that may be stolen by a character.”; “a different” → “another”; “trooper reaches” → “reached by”; added “place”; “card goes” → “Utinni Effect”; “trooper; trooper” → “target; target”; “+ 2, target is "stolen",” → “+2, steals opponent’s card,”; added “may”; “Force = destiny number of target.” → “3 Force.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 44. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Send A Detachment Down]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
